what_to_detect: A triggered ability with an intervening-if condition on its trigger (CheckSVar$, LifeTotal$, IsPresent$ and the like) whose condition still holds when it resolves, so its effect half acts.
near_miss: An intervening-if triggered ability that fired but whose condition is false when it resolves, so it is removed from the stack and its resolution has no effect events.
record_fields: trigger record fired true, the trigger line's root script carrying an intervening-if parameter
the same ability's resolution record: activation outcome and effect-half events (present or empty)

what_to_detect: A resolution whose effect half holds a destroyed event with regenerable false (the destruction can't be regenerated): the permanent dies even under a regeneration shield.
near_miss: A destroyed event with regenerable true on a shielded permanent, followed by a regenerated event and a rewrite record.
record_fields: regenerated event on the near-miss side

what_to_detect: A resolution whose effect reads a number from an object that left its zone during the same resolution (its last known information).
near_miss: A resolution whose object stayed in place, so current information equals last known information.

what_to_detect: A trigger whose condition looks back at the turn's history (CheckSVar$ on a turn count such as attackers declared) fires because the condition held earlier in the turn, even though the creature that met it no longer exists.
near_miss: A trigger of that kind evaluated in a turn where its historical condition is unmet, which does not fire.
record_fields: trigger line's root CheckSVar$ and the SVar's Count$ definition (sidecar script)

what_to_detect: A resolution whose selector names one colour (all black creatures) affects a multicoloured permanent that has that colour among others.
near_miss: A permanent without that colour, which the resolution leaves unaffected.
record_fields: acting line's ValidCards$ / ValidTgts$ colour test (sidecar script)

what_to_detect: A resolution whose selector excludes one colour (all nonblack creatures) spares a multicoloured permanent that has that colour among others.
near_miss: A permanent without that colour, which the resolution affects.
record_fields: acting line's ValidCards$ colour test (sidecar script)

what_to_detect: A delayed or triggered ability acting on the permanent it remembered after that permanent stopped having the card type it was remembered with, such as returning a former creature.
near_miss: The same kind of ability acting on a remembered permanent that still has that type.
record_fields: effect-half zone_change of the remembered entity

what_to_detect: An Aura spell cast with bestow whose target is illegal on resolution does not fizzle: it moves from the stack to the battlefield as a creature, with no attached event.
near_miss: A bestowed Aura spell whose target is still legal on resolution, which enters the battlefield with an attached event naming its target.
record_fields: effect-half zone_change from stack to battlefield

what_to_detect: A mutating creature spell's resolution after which the target's card lists mutate components: it merged.
near_miss: A mutating spell that entered alone because its target was illegal.

what_to_detect: A copy of a permanent spell resolving: its zone_change from the stack to the battlefield names an entity the snapshot marks as a token.
near_miss: A permanent spell that is not a copy resolving and entering the battlefield as a card (no token).
record_fields: effect-half zone_change stack to battlefield of a spell copy
the spell_copied event that made the copy
the entering entity's token flag in the snapshot

what_to_detect: A permanent spell whose static ability (dash, and the like) creates a delayed triggered ability as it resolves: a delayed_trigger_created event in the same effect half as its zone_change from the stack to the battlefield, read for the scenario's trigger record kind.
near_miss: A permanent spell entering the battlefield with no delayed_trigger_created event.
